memories.content: The French Presidency is responsible for managing the COP21 negotiations and aims to produce a draft agreement text. They have the authority to circulate texts to national delegations.

COP21 is the 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference held in Paris. The summit is scheduled to conclude on December 11, 2015. The French Presidency is expected to produce and circulate consolidated draft agreement texts during the negotiations.
